chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Faḍālah, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Wahb, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
The adhān is in pairs, and the iqāmah is one by one.

key_terms.الْإِقَامَةُ: the call announcing the immediate commencement of salat (prayer)
key_terms.مَثْنَى: in pairs; repeated two at a time

ai.seo_question: How many times are the phrases of the adhān and iqāmah recited according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal form for the number of phrases in the adhān and the iqāmah. It indicates that the adhān is recited in pairs, while the iqāmah is recited singly.
